summary: Trivial forwarder that releases a synchronization lock by calling CritSectLeave with lock slot index 13 and returns its result. The ABI lead labels this function Critical_Section_Leave.

operations.description: Call CritSectLeave(0x58E04B) with constant lock index 13; its return value is the function result.
Return the value produced by CritSectLeave unchanged.

unresolved: The subsystem owning critical-section slot 13 is unknown; the constant has no packet evidence linking it to a named resource.
Why callers sub_587AC0 and sub_589CC6 route lock release through this indirection instead of calling CritSectLeave directly is unresolved.
